name: create diagram from words
route: Choose diagram type; use hand-written XML for custom shapes or autolayout.py for >15 nodes.

name: find exact official shape
route: Run ontology/query_ontology.py first, then shapesearch.py; never guess mxgraph style names.

name: find AI brand icon
route: Query icons_search.jsonl; prefer local SVG, or aiicons.py --embed for portable .drawio.

name: code structure
route: Use language importer -> graph JSON -> autolayout.py -> validate.py.

name: declared infrastructure
route: Use tfimports.py, k8simports.py, or composeimports.py -> autolayout.py.

name: live infrastructure
route: Use tfstate.py, dockerimports.py, or k8simports.py with stdin.

name: sequence interactions
route: Use seqlayout.py; do not hand-place lifelines.

name: review or validate
route: Run edgeports.py where needed, then validate.py; inspect exported PNG.

name: publish or convert
route: Use drawiohtml.py, drawio2pptx.py, drawio2mermaid.py, or svgflow.py.

name: localize or restyle
route: Use relabel.py or restyle.py; retain layout and identifiers.

name: compare diagrams
route: Use drawiodiff.py; for PR workflows use prdiff.py.
